automation_tiers.CTO_AUTOMATE: Full parametric spec and quote-grade BOM generated automatically; fast-path human approval — approver reviews, does not co-design.
automation_tiers.ETO_GUIDED: Standard sub-components auto-priced; the bespoke remainder is captured as a basis-of-design and routed to a specialist engineer — no spec is claimed for the bespoke portion.
automation_tiers.ETO_EXCEPTION: No design attempt is made; the requirement is captured with a margin-protected price placeholder; 100% of design work is routed to specialist engineers.

layers.name: Grid Interface

brands.name: EPC Power (pending close)
brands.tier_rationale: Novel grid-forming / 800VDC power conversion topology — high-complexity ETO, per EPC Power's own product profile.

layers.description: Grid-forming power conversion, 800V DC, on-site storage / microgrid support.
selection_rules: If voltage_arch mentions '800VDC' or 'grid-forming', prefer EPC Power.
If no grid-scale storage/microgrid requirement is present, note EPC Power scope may be reduced to conversion only.

layers.name: Utility / Facility Electrical

brands.name: Crown Technical Systems
brands.tier_rationale: Bespoke arc-resistant switchgear and E-Houses engineered per utility/site spec.

brands.name: EP2
brands.tier_rationale: Explicitly labeled 'Engineered-to-order' on Flex's own site; bespoke substation control and protection panels.

brands.name: Anord Mardix
brands.tier_rationale: Standardized, modular switchgear and building blocks configured from parametric rules.

layers.description: MV/LV switchgear, substation control, protection, E-Houses.
selection_rules: If requirement mentions utility substation control or protection panels, prefer EP2.
If requirement mentions arc-resistant MV switchgear or E-Houses, prefer Crown Technical Systems.
If requirement is general LV/MV switchgear without a specific utility-grade need, prefer Anord Mardix.

layers.name: Power Distribution (Room to Row to Rack)

brands.name: Anord Mardix
brands.tier_rationale: Modular power pods and busway are SpinCo's most standardized, highest CTO-volume product line.

layers.description: Busway, PDUs, RPPs, prefabricated modular power pods.
selection_rules: If deployment_preference mentions 'modular' or 'prefabricated', prefer Anord Mardix modular power pods.
Default to standard busway + PDU distribution otherwise.

layers.name: Rack & Board Power

brands.name: Flex Power Modules
brands.tier_rationale: Catalog board-level DC-DC converters and power shelves, standardized part numbers.

brands.name: EPC Power
brands.tier_rationale: Same novel 800VDC conversion technology as Layer 1 — high-complexity ETO.

layers.description: Power shelves, rack power, DC-DC modules, chip-level power.
selection_rules: If voltage_arch specifies 800VDC at rack level, prefer EPC Power for rack-level conversion in combination with Flex Power Modules for board-level DC-DC.
If voltage_arch is standard 48VDC or 415VAC, prefer Flex Power Modules alone.

layers.name: Thermal Management

brands.name: JetCool
brands.tier_rationale: Productized cold plates and CDUs (SmartPlate, SmartSense) with configurable, catalog-driven options.

layers.description: Cold plates, direct liquid-to-chip, CDUs, turn-key liquid cooling.
selection_rules: If rack_density_kw >= 100, require direct-to-chip liquid cooling (JetCool SmartPlate + CDU).
If rack_density_kw is between 35 and 100, hybrid air/liquid acceptable.
If rack_density_kw < 35, air cooling may be sufficient; flag for engineering review.

layers.name: Compute + Integration

brands.name: Cloud (organic)
brands.tier_rationale: Rack-scale integration of already-selected components — assembly, not bespoke design.

selection_rules: Always included when the RFP scope extends to rack-scale integration, not just component supply.

component_overrides.reason: Standard enclosures are catalog items even within an otherwise bespoke EP2/Crown panel.
Standard busbar fittings are catalog components regardless of the surrounding panel's engineering complexity.
Standard breaker families are catalog-selectable even inside a bespoke protection panel.
Explicit signal of a first-of-kind design reinforces exception routing even if a brand default were otherwise automated.
Explicit novelty signal overrides any brand default toward mandatory specialist routing.
